output.answer_markdown: Interest expense includes amortization of capitalized debt issuance costs, offset by amortization of debt premium and interest income earned on cash and cash equivalents [1]. It excludes interest incurred on construction projects to build, upgrade, or remodel certain facilities, because that interest is capitalized to property and equipment [2]. Other (income) expense, net includes changes in fair value on beneficial interests in securitizations, purchase price adjustment receivables, and fair value adjustments related to Root Warrants [3], along with other general expenses such as gains or losses from disposals of long-lived assets [4]. For the year ended December 31, 2023, it also newly includes expense from the recognition of the Tax Receivable Agreement reserve [5].
